reason: BeginFrameSystem opens the frame: one GPUCommandEncoder for the frame, and getCurrentTexture with its view for each presenting camera. WebGPU mints all three per frame by design.
EndFrameSystem closes the frame: one GPUCommandBuffer per submit, a single-use WebGPU object.
renderColor opens the geometry pass: one GPURenderPassEncoder per presenting camera. The draws inside it are one recorded render bundle, replayed.
renderCascades opens the cascade atlas passes: one GPUComputePassEncoder for the re-gather and one GPURenderPassEncoder per indirect-source batch, both single-use.
PartSystem opens the pack pass: one GPUComputePassEncoder per frame, carrying all three dispatches.
LightCullSystem opens the light pass: one GPUComputePassEncoder per frame, carrying the compact and cull dispatches.
GlazeSystem composites to the swapchain: one GPUComputePassEncoder per presenting camera, and one GPUBindGroup over that frame's swapchain view, which getCurrentTexture replaces every frame.
